items.title: Germany Proposes 25% Flat Tax on Crypto Gains
points: Germany proposes a 25% flat tax rate on all cryptocurrency capital gains, replacing the previous progressive tax bracket system
Applies uniformly regardless of holding period or transaction size, simplifying compliance for an estimated 5+ million German crypto holders
Could set a template for EU-wide crypto tax standardization, though the rate may be less competitive than crypto-friendly jurisdictions like El Salvador or Malta
Provides long-sought tax clarity that could attract institutional investment despite the relatively high rate

items.title: Block Files for Federal Bank Charter
points: Block filed an application with the OCC (Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, the US regulator that charters national banks) to establish Builders Bank & Trust, an uninsured national trust bank for crypto custody and fiduciary services including bitcoin and stablecoins
21 of 40 de novo (newly formed) bank charter applications have been approved by the OCC since 2025
Other crypto/fintech firms seeking similar charters include Coinbase, Paxos, BitGo, Ripple, Circle, Revolut, and World Liberty Financial

items.title: Robinhood Takes Minority Stake in Crypto.com
points: Robinhood acquired a minority stake in Crypto.com, deepening retail crypto platform consolidation
Follows Robinhood's 2024 acquisition of Bitstamp

items.title: Tokenized Stocks Hit $1 Billion Volume Over Holiday Weekend
points: Tokenized stocks (blockchain-based tokens representing shares of real equities) traded $1.01 billion over Labor Day weekend while US markets were closed, nearly matching the $1.02 billion traded the prior Friday when markets were open
Robinhood Chain captured 57% of weekend flow ($572.8M), followed by Binance's bStocks ($303.5M) and Backed Finance's xStocks ($87.1M)
Decentralized exchanges (DEXs, trading platforms that operate without a central intermediary) handled the majority of volume, with centralized venues taking only about 8%
Prices tracked Friday's closing prices with minimal premiums throughout the market closure, across 42 tokenized instruments

items.title: EtherFi Cash Launches Tiered Membership Program
points: New program offers cashback up to 4%, with scaled benefits
Higher tiers require holding staked ETHFI tokens

items.title: Stablecoin Infrastructure and Card Expansion
points: Flex, which processes $20B in annualized fiat volume, launched stablecoin wallets enabling a single account for fiat, stablecoins, and cards
Visa's stablecoin-linked card ecosystem grew to 160+ active programs with $20B in annualized settlement volume, up 15x year-over-year
Credit Coop created a stablecoin-denominated revolving credit facility that cut borrowing costs by up to 30%, financing $2.5B cumulative volume since 2023 with zero defaults
Rain launched Global Payouts, enabling stablecoin-funded payments to 50 currencies across 80+ countries

items.title: Ethereum Researchers Simulate Gas Limit Increase
points: Simulation tested raising Ethereum's gas limit (the cap on computational work allowed per block) from 60 million to 200 million across 12 demand scenarios
Nine of twelve scenarios settled near 50% block utilization after a 10-hour adjustment period
Median base fees (the minimum fee required per transaction) ranged from under 0.0001 gwei to 0.39 gwei depending on demand and elasticity assumptions
At 2x demand, base fees varied 18-fold across different elasticity models, showing block utilization alone cannot predict fees after the upgrade

sections.title: Germany's Cryptocurrency Tax Proposal

Proposal applies uniformly regardless of holding period or transaction size, creating administrative simplicity for tax authorities and investors
Framework expected to affect estimated 5+ million German crypto holders and influence EU-wide tax policy discussions

sections.title: Market and Regulatory Implications

Certainty from fixed rate may attract institutional investment despite higher burden compared to some competing jurisdictions
Tax treatment clarity addresses long-standing EU regulatory gap, though rate competitiveness versus crypto-friendly nations like El Salvador or Malta remains a factor

sections.title: 4. Ethereum Research: Fee Market Dynamics at Higher Gas Limits
points: Simulation of proposed 60M to 200M gas limit increase across 12 demand scenarios showed nine of twelve settled near 50% block utilization after 10-hour adjustment period
Median base fees ranged from under 0.0001 gwei to 0.39 gwei depending on demand level and price elasticity assumptions
At 2x demand, base fees varied 18-fold across elasticity models (0.006 to 0.106 gwei), indicating block utilization alone cannot predict fee outcomes post-upgrade
Three low-demand scenarios failed to reach 100M-gas utilization even at near-zero base fees, shifting costs to priority tips
